# Keif Electric

> Licensed residential electrician based in San Luis Obispo, California, serving San Luis Obispo County. Owner-operated by Adam Keif. California C-10 electrical contractor license #1152084.

Keif Electric is a one-person residential electrical shop. The work is finish-focused: panel upgrades, EV charger installation, lighting, troubleshooting, and full electrical for new builds and remodels. Adam does the work himself, pulls the permits, and handles inspections.

- Phone: (805) 286-0477
- Email: adam@keifelectric.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm
- Service area: San Luis Obispo, Atascadero, Paso Robles, Templeton, Santa Margarita, Arroyo Grande, Morro Bay, Los Osos, Cayucos, Cambria, Pismo Beach, Santa Maria

## Services

- [EV charger installation](https://keifelectric.com/ev-charger-installation-san-luis-obispo): Level 2 home charger installs, panel assessment, dedicated 240V circuit, permit and inspection.
- [Electrical panel upgrades](https://keifelectric.com/electrical-panel-upgrade-san-luis-obispo): 100-amp to 200-amp service upgrades and panel replacements, including PG&E coordination. Federal Pacific and Zinsco replacements.
- [Lighting installation](https://keifelectric.com/lighting-installation-san-luis-obispo): Recessed lighting, chandeliers, exterior and landscape lighting, dimmers and smart controls.
- [Electrical repair and troubleshooting](https://keifelectric.com/electrical-repair-san-luis-obispo): Flickering lights, tripping breakers, dead outlets, mystery circuits. Flat diagnostic fee that applies toward the repair.
- [New build and remodel electrical](https://keifelectric.com/new-construction-electrical-san-luis-obispo): Full residential electrical for new construction and major remodels. Rough-in through finish trim, coordinated with your GC.
- [ADU electrical](https://keifelectric.com/adu-electrical-san-luis-obispo): Load calculations on the existing service, subpanel or separate service, feeders and trenching, and full ADU wiring rough-in to finish.
